gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-gafata: Expressive from the first letter, Funnel Display draws spaghetti-like strokes of one width, while Gafata stands tall with short stalks. The flat fineliner-like heading against the tall body is what lingers.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-gidole: Gidole keeps its terminals apart like open scissor blades. Funnel Display brings commanding, spaghetti-like strokes up top, and Gidole's neon-tube consistency lets the body text go a size smaller.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-hind-mysuru: Spaghetti lines, big attitude: Funnel Display leads with same-width strokes and commanding presence. Hind Mysuru follows with tops pressed close to the ascender height and no calligraphic thinning, which makes paragraphs run smoothly.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-hind-siliguri: Commanding up top, Funnel Display holds spaghetti-like strokes to one width everywhere. Hind Siliguri is built for settling in, its constant line weight humming a flat gray and approachable.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-hind-vadodara: Spaghetti lines, firm voice: Funnel Display holds every stroke to one width for grand entrances. Hind Vadodara handles the reading, with spacious terminal gaps and big, open-looking lowercase bowls that stay uniform in thickness.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-huninn: Huninn reads modern and sturdy, with crossbars as fat as its stems, beside Funnel Display and its spaghetti-like strokes. Give the body text a notch less size than the heading.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-kedebideri: Laser-cut and spaghetti-straight, Funnel Display holds one stroke width, while Kedebideri lifts a skyward x-height line over rounded, inviting letters. Shrink the heading or enlarge the body, and the difference fades.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-copti: No brush swell here, just flat, commanding lines. Funnel Display holds one stroke width, a steady foil for Noto Sans Coptic, whose middle zone dominates each line with open s and c mouths.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-cunei: Funnel Display draws a flat, unswelling line along every curve, spaghetti-like and commanding in its single width. Against it, Noto Sans Cuneiform swells like glass beads, its e opening wide.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-duplo: Clean and plain-outlined, Funnel Display is all spaghetti-like single-width stroke. Noto Sans Duployan has oversized counters and a lowercase a with a wide mouth, so a modest body size stays inviting.
